players.bio: Ben Jones-Bishop (born 24 August 1988) is a Jamaica international rugby league footballer who plays as a winger or fullback for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League. After impressing for the club's academy team, he made his début for the Rhinos' in April 2008, in the victory over the Crusaders in the Rugby League Challenge Cup.

Danny Richardson (born 2 September 1996) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half or stand-off for York Knights in the RFL Championship on loan from Hull Kingston Rovers in the Super League. He has also played for the England Knights at international level.

Denive Balmforth (born 1 October 2003) is an English-born professional rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker or loose forward for York Knights, on loan from Hull F.C. in the Super League and Wales. In 2022, he made his Hull début in the Super League against Toulouse Olympique.
Jack Martin is an Australian prop forward who currently plays for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League.

Jesse Dee is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who currently plays as a back-rower or centre for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League. Born on 25 October 1994, the 31-year-old has become a cornerstone of the York squad,

John Sagaga is a prop forward who recently signed with the York Knights for the 2026 Super League season. A product of the elite Penrith Panthers development system in Australia, the 21-year-old is considered a high-potential talent following his recruitment to the UK on a two-year contract.

Jon Bennison (born 1 December 2002) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger and fullback for York Knights. Previously Bennison has played for St Helens and Widnes Vikings. Throughout the 2021 Under-19s season, Bennison made eight appearances, scoring seven tries across the campaign.

Jordan Lipp (born 10 January 2001) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who currently plays for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League. Standing at 195 cm, he is a versatile backline player capable of playing at full-back, centre, wing, or half-back, and is a proficient goal-kicker.

Jordan Thompson (born 4 September 1991) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row or loose forward for the York Knights in the Championship. He has previously played for the Castleford Tigers in the Super League, and on loan from Castleford at the York City Knights in the Championship.

Josh Griffin (born 9 May 1990) is an English rugby league footballer who plays as a centre or second-rower for York Knights in the Super League. He has previously played for the Hull FC, Huddersfield Giants, Castleford Tigers (Heritage № 921) and the Salford Red Devils in the Super League.
Justin Sangaré (born 7 March 1998) is a France international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the York Knights. He is a product of the Toulouse academy system.
Kieran Hudson is a professional rugby league prop who currently wears the number 17 shirt for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League.

Kieran Buchanan (born 26 January 1999) is a Scotland international rugby league footballer who plays as a centre, winger or fullback for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League . He has previously played for Hull F.C. in the Super League and spent time on loan from Hull at Doncaster in League 1.

Liam Harris (born 20 April 1997) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half for the York Knights in the Super League. He played for Hull Kingston Rovers in the Championship, and on loan from Hull KR at the York City Knights in Kingstone Press League 1. He played for Doncaster in League 1 and Hull FC in the Super League.

Mafoa'aeata "Ata" Hingano (born 11 March 1997) is a Tonga international rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half, stand-off or hooker for the York Knights in the English Super League. He has played for the New Zealand Warriors and the Canberra Raiders in the NRL.

Matty Foster is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for the York Knights in the Super League. He spent time on loan from the Saints at the Leigh Centurions in the Super League.

Mitch Clark (born 30 March 1993) is a New Zealand Māori international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League. He has previously played for the Penrith Panthers in the Holden Cup, Doncaster in Kingstone Press championship, and the Bradford Bulls and Hull Kingston Rovers in the Championship.
Oli Field is a professional rugby league player who currently plays for York Knights in the Betfred Super League.

Paul McShane (born 19 November 1989) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker or scrum-half for the York Knights in the RFL Championship. He has represented England at international level, and was the recipient of the Man of Steel award in 2020. He has previously played for the Leeds Rhinos, and on loan from Leeds at Hull F.C., Widnes Vikings and the Hunslet Hawks.

Paul Vaughan (born 23 April 1991) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop forward for the York Knights in the Super League. He has played for both Italy and Australia at international level. He previously played for the St.

Sam Wood (born 11 July 1997) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays for as a centre or winger for the York Knights in the Super League. He has previously played for the Huddersfield Giants and Hull Kingston Rovers in the Super League.

Scott Galeano is a 27-year-old Australian professional rugby league footballer who currently plays as a winger or centre for the York Knights in the Betfred Super League. Known for his speed and finishing ability, he has quickly become a key figure for the Knights since moving to the UK in early 2025.

Toa Mata'afa (born April 7, 1997) is a Samoan professional rugby league player who signed with the York Knights until the end of 2026. A versatile back (full-back, winger, or centre), he previously played in France for FC Lézignan and Baroudeur de Pia, as well as for the North Sydney Bears in the NSW Cu.

William Dagger (born 21 February 1999) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays fullback, wing, centre, stand-off, scrum-half for York Knights in the RFL Championship. He primarily plays as a fullback, but he can also play on the wing, he has also occasionally featured as a stand-off and scrum-half.

Xavier Va'a (born 17 November 2003) is a Samoan professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the York Knights in the Super League. He previously played for the Sydney Roosters in the NRL.
